summary: A reported U.S. strike on an air defense system on Iran's Qeshm Island triggered explosions heard in Bandar Abbas, while Iranian MP Manouchehr Mottaki threatened to expand conflict to Europe. Israeli forces concluded an 11-day operation in Hebron and killed four Hamas operatives in northern Gaza. Lebanon recorded 164 alerts and 88 drone sightings on November 2, including one drone strike and five airstrikes.
key_points: U.S. strike hit air defense system on Qeshm Island, causing explosions heard in Bandar Abbas, per Iranian reports. (Source: @N12chat/233017)
Iranian MP Manouchehr Mottaki warned further U.S. attacks could spread conflict to Europe, claiming Iranian missiles can reach the continent. (Source: @yediotnews25/137169)
Israeli forces withdrew from several Hebron neighborhoods after an 11-day operation launched in response to a deadly checkpoint shooting. (Source: @manniefabian/59463)
IDF strikes in northern Gaza killed four Hamas operatives, including Nukhba Force member Wael Naif Fahmi Muslim and recruitment chief Nabil Hamad. (Source: @manniefabian/59461)

Lebanon's daily alert report for November 2 recorded 164 alerts, 88 drone sightings, one drone strike in Kfar Tibnit, five airstrikes, and 27 artillery shelling incidents across southern districts. (Source: @redlinkleb/51426)

Qatari delegation led by senior diplomat Ali al-Duwadi arrived in Tehran to meet FM Abbas Araghchi, continuing Iran-U.S. talks after multiple rounds in Iran and Qatar. (Source: @N12chat/233010, @N12chat/233011)

Air defense activity reported at Iranian air bases in Omidiyeh (Khuzestan) and Marivan (Kurdistan), plus numerous explosions on Qeshm Island. (Source: @shin_persian/11911, @shin_persian/11917, @shin_persian/11913)
UN reports all roads into Yemen's besieged Taiz closed, trapping 250,000 residents and threatening 12 hospitals with closure amid cholera outbreak. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9371)

points: A reported U.S. strike targeted an air defense system on Qeshm Island in Hormozgan Province, with explosions heard in the port city of Bandar Abbas, according to Iranian reports. (Source: @N12chat/233017)

Iranian MP Manouchehr Mottaki threatened that further U.S. attacks could expand the conflict to Europe, asserting Iranian missiles can reach the continent and accusing European states of hosting U.S. bases. (Source: @yediotnews25/137169)

Air defense activity was detected at the Omidiyeh air base in Khuzestan Province and at Marivan in Kurdistan Province at 2128Z, per monitoring posts. (Source: @shin_persian/11911, @shin_persian/11917)
Numerous explosions were reported on Qeshm Island, Hormozgan Province, via delayed incident feeds. (Source: @shin_persian/11913)

Iran added 114 vessels to the PGSA Non-Compliance List, bringing the total to 240 listed vessels, with Orbital analysis identifying registered owners and exposure from the list's cooperation clause. (Source: @shin_persian/11923)
Balochi regions of Iran have seen poppy cultivation expand to approximately 9,000 hectares, mirroring growth in Pakistani Balochistan, according to Radio Free Europe. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9378)
A VIP aircraft departed Tehran with its hex code blocked, assessed as possibly Emirati, Saudi, or Qatari. (Source: @shin_persian/11916)

Israeli forces completed withdrawal from several neighborhoods in Hebron after an 11-day operation initiated in response to a deadly shooting attack at a checkpoint on the city's outskirts. (Source: @manniefabian/59463)

The IDF announced the killing of four Hamas operatives in northern Gaza strikes: Nabil Hamad (recruitment apparatus department head), Mohannad Nader Mahmoud Dahdouh (sniper commander), Wael Naif Fahmi Muslim (Nukhba Force member who participated in October 7), and Arafat Kamal Muhammad Ar'air (rocket squad commander). (Source: @manniefabian/59461)
An IDF military drone crashed near the southern town of Beit Shikma due to a technical malfunction, igniting a fire in an open area with no injuries reported. (Source: @manniefabian/59464)

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir declared the military has an obligation to become a global leader in AI and robotics, outlining a concept of integrated human-machine warfare where manned units coordinate with unmanned systems for battlefield superiority. (Source: @manniefabian/59467)
Israeli forces withdrew from multiple Hebron neighborhoods following an 11-day raid launched after a fatal checkpoint shooting, per Palestinian media. (Source: @manniefabian/59463)

Separate IDF strikes in northern Gaza on Saturday and October 22 eliminated four Hamas operatives, including a Nukhba Force veteran of the October 7 attack and a recruitment department head, with the IDF stating they were actively restoring Hamas capabilities in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59461)

Lebanon's November 2 daily alert summary recorded 164 total alerts, 88 drone sightings, with Meifdon and Jibshit each recording seven sightings, and a 100% targeting rate after detection (one drone strike in Kfar Tibnit). (Source: @redlinkleb/51426)

Israeli airstrikes struck Kfar Tibnit (two), Aita al-Jabal (two), and Al-Qasir (one), while artillery shelling hit 27 locations across southern districts including Barishit (five), Wadi al-Sulouqi (four), and Al-Mansouri (four). (Source: @redlinkleb/51426)
An electric VTOL drone was observed over the Hamadiyeh-Bas-Jal al-Bahr area in the Tyre district. (Source: @redlinkleb/51410)

Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani and Lebanese Deputy PM Tarek Mitri met in Damascus to discuss refugee returns, education, and administrative obstacles, with Beirut estimating 1.12 million Syrian refugees remain in Lebanon. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9369)
Syrian FM Asaad al-Shaibani and Lebanese Deputy PM Tarek Mitri held talks in Damascus on refugee returns, education, and administrative hurdles, per SANA. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9369)
